{{Quote|Visitors from a distant world. Car'das and Ferasi, may I present Admiral Ar'alani.|Thrawn, introducing Ar'alani to his guests|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
'''Ar'alani''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] who served in the [[Chiss Defense Fleet]] of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy's]] [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|Expansionary Defense Fleet]]. As a member of the [[Defense Hierarchy]], which served as the high command of the entire Expansionary Defense Force, Ar'alani had been obliged to resign her status in one of the [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]], and to devote herself entirely to the military. In contrast to the [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Defense Fleet uniform]]s with shoulder patches in the Family colors that were the normal dress of Chiss military personnel, she wore a pure white uniform.

==Biography==
Shortly before [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Outbound Flight Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> Ar'alani commanded the [[Ar'alani's force|force]] that [[Battle between the Chiss and Yuuzhan Vong|defeated]] a [[Yuuzhan Vong reconnaissance force|reconnaissance force]] of [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. Shortly afterward, she arrived at [[Crustai]] to intervene in the actions of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] against the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]], and to investigate the appearance of the Human smugglers [[Dubrak Qennto]], [[Maris Ferasi]] and [[Jorj Car'das]]. The Chiss were concerned that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Yuuzhan Vong might be in league and coordinating attacks against the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

Despite her frequent clashes with Thrawn over the morality of his tactics, her duplicitous aid enabled the Force Commander to lure the Vagaari into a trap. After Mitth'raw'nuruodo successfully captured a Vagaari 'treasure' ship, she backed him in opposing the [[Chaf family/Legends|Chaf family]], who sought the spoils of war for their own ends. Syndic Mitth'ras'safis 'requested' her to look into the activities of Thrawn after the apparent loss of the ''Whirlwind'', yet she covertly allied herself with Thrawn again, lying to various members of the CEDF about Jorj Car'das when she 'forgave' Thrawn for allowing the 'spy' to escape. In this instance her concern for the safety of the Chiss overrode the strict codes of war forbidding preemptive strikes, as Car'das's escape was a lure designed by Thrawn for the purpose of capturing both the Vagaari and [[Outbound Flight Project]]. Ar'alani was even actively involved in the next phase of the operation; liberating the [[Geroon (species)|Geroon]] home world. While this may have been an entirely innocent gesture on her part, this is doubtful, as her absence allowed Thrawn to provide data on the Vong to [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]], in exchange for his loyalty and assistance in eliminating the Vagaari and the Outbound Flight.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

==Personality and traits==
Ar'alani had glowing eyes.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ar'alani first appeared in the [[2006]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> The character's name is a [[tuckerization]] of Ara Roselani, a friend of Timothy Zahn.<ref name="Ar'alani">{{WebCite|url=https://www.aralani.com/admiral-aralani|text=Why "Aralani"? - Aralani Photography &#124; Portland Wedding Photographer|archivedate=20230625122322}}</ref> An [[:File:ChissFemale.jpg|image]] from ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'' depicts a member of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] species with clothing<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> that matches Ar'alani's clothing in ''Outbound Flight'', however, no connection has been established.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
